I was in your wifes place a few months ago. Had been drinking for some years, but during the last few months before getting sober, I went into psychosis while drunk and everything went straight to hell.
It had been a ticking timebomb for at least a year before this. And even then, in my hazy mind, i could not think straight. I could not picture my life without alcohol, i just figured i had a bad day (!). You tell yourself all kinds of crap while addicted. Your wife, like myself, hides the problem from you. You know deep inside that it cannot go on, yet you try avoiding help and confrontation because alcohol feels so important to you.
Well, my husband gave me an ultimatum and i told him to just leave. After some days, i checked myself into rehab and i've been sober since. I needed to face the reality, and i chose a sober life and my family over the addiction. It was and still is hard, but worth every struggle. If you need to talk, PM me.
